title: Qaiji-IR (开济IR): A Cross-Layer Quantum-Classical Digital-Twin Intermediate Representation
description:
Qaiji-IR is a cross-layer intermediate representation for hybrid quantum-classical computing. It keeps semantic authority inside the IR and treats OpenQASM 3, QIR and MLIR as adapter, target and bridge rather than as parents.

The code base provides a circuit-level front-end model, a bidirectional OpenQASM 2/3 codec that loudly rejects unsupported constructs, executable basis and phase convention checks, an L4 semantic-preservation core, an L5 program IR, and an L2 native-schedule IR with independent certification.
